title: Finite polynomial algebra action on successive coherent formal kernels
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $X$ a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ a morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Put $J=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and let $F$ be a coherent formal module for $J$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Write $K_0=F_1$ and $K_{n+1}=\ker(F_{n+2}\to F_{n+1})$ [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces]. Then there is $r\in\mathbf N$ such that the polynomial ring $P=A[T_1,\ldots,T_r]$, graded by total degree with homogeneous submodules $P_k$, acts on the pieces by $\mathcal O_X$-linear sheaf maps $\mu_{m,k}(b):K_m\to K_{m+k}$, additive in $b\in P_k$. They satisfy $\mu_{m+l,k}(b)\circ\mu_{m,l}(b\prime)=\mu_{m,k+l}(bb\prime)$ for $b\in P_k,b\prime\in P_l$, and constants $a\in A=P_0$ act on sections by $f^\sharp(a)$. For each point $x\in X$ there is an open neighbourhood $U$ and finitely many sections $t_i\in K_0(U)$ such that, for every $m$, every open $V\subseteq U$, every $v\in K_m(V)$ and every $y\in V$, some open $y\in W\subseteq V$ has $v|_W$ in the $\mathcal O_X(W)$-span of $\mu_{0,m}(b)(t_i|_W)$ for $b\in P_m$. No properness, ample sheaf or cohomological assertion is assumed.

proof.text: Choose finite generators x_1,...,x_r of I, using that every ideal of a Noetherian ring is finitely generated [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. The total-degree-graded polynomial A-algebra A[T_1,...,T_r] maps onto gr_I(A), sending a to its class modulo I and T_i to the class of x_i modulo I^2. Each degree n is surjective because products of the generators span I^n.

Put J = I O_X. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-ideal-quotient], on each affine open J is the ideal generated by the images of the x_i. Products show that every section of J^k/J^(k+1) locally is an O_X-linear combination of the degree-k monomials in these images. The evaluation maps from the pulled-back polynomial algebra to the graded ideal sheaf algebra are thus locally surjective in every degree; they commute with restrictions, addition and multiplication.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-kernel-rees-finite] to F and J. Its graded module action on the pieces [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces] can be restricted along the polynomial evaluation maps. For each degree-k polynomial b, evaluation and this action define an O_X-linear sheaf map mu(m,k,b):K_m → K_(m+k). The algebra and module laws imply additivity in b and the displayed graded composition identity. The degree-zero polynomial C(a) evaluates to f-sharp(a), giving exactly the scalar identity on every open.

Use the finite local degree-zero generators supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-kernel-rees-finite]. A section of K_m locally is a sum of their restrictions with coefficients in J^m/J^(m+1). Lift these finitely many coefficients through the local surjection of step 2, shrinking to a common neighbourhood. Expand the lifts as O_X-linear combinations of homogeneous degree-m polynomials. This places the restricted section in the stated span of polynomial actions on the degree-zero generators. This works for all opens V contained in the generating neighbourhood and all points y in V.
